title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: source-concept frequency envelopes for narrow referents versus reusable grammatical roles
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Replace a free Winter guess with an explicitly conditional source-side prior: test whether complete already cached readable works separate narrow season/age/entity concepts from reusable grammatical functions after concept-level counting, genre matching and whole-work transfer. Only a surviving semantic frequency envelope could change which whole-reading candidates receive attention; it cannot translate daiin or decide a function from rank one.

design.mechanism: A named narrow concept imposes a book-level semantic demand that an unconstrained closed-class relation does not: its tokens must repeatedly refer to that concept across many independent source units. Estimate that demand from independently readable, already cached primary controls at concept level, including inflected forms and ordinary synonyms under a fixed annotation rule. A target candidate is examined only under explicit one-whole/one-sense and comparable-document assumptions. This is a hypothesis-priority envelope, not an identity-free operator classifier.
design.unit: One complete admitted readable work or independently bounded complete chapter family, with document-native units retained; at least three independent works must survive source/license/scope checks before implementation. Use existing GDT380 comparator receipts and existing owned Laufenberg source transcripts for navigation only. Never treat three transcriptions of Voynich as three books. No raw mixed target TSV, new image, reserve or external acquisition is needed for intake.
design.contrast: Specific recurring content: one named season, age class or concrete medical substance; generic content: body/person/material; reusable function: universal quantification, copula, conjunction or reference. These are separate declared hypotheses, not interchangeable labels on one score. Source annotation must record actual referential uses, metalinguistic mention and formulaic headings separately; the source list and meaning list are fixed before any target comparison.
design.prediction: If a narrowly specific candidate is a useful prior, the complete-work concept footprints of that class must remain distinguishable from common functions in leave-one-work-out assessment after total exposure and native unit length are matched, including a held work with repetitive medical headings. If not, frequency cannot prioritize that candidate class. For the already exposed daiin profile, any comparison must disclose rank one, 169/179 ZL selectors and Currier asymmetry as observations, not fitted thresholds. No favorable single work or section may be selected afterward.
design.scope: Source-side feasibility first; existing 179-selector Voynich profile is already exposed and may receive only an exploratory sensitivity comparison after the entire source design is frozen. No newly independent confirmation is claimed.
paid_assumptions: The exact Voynich whole under discussion normally carries one lexical sense, rather than a polysemous word, homograph bundle, abbreviation, register-dependent operator or whole clause.
Concept-level source counts approximate the unknown Voynich encoder's content granularity; allomorph splitting and phrase compression can invalidate this bridge.
The selected readable works reasonably cover the manuscript's actual mixture of topics and functions; no language or genre is selected by the desired outcome.
Source annotations are independent of existing Voynich word assignments. Inherited German workshop renderings are not training labels.
observable_inputs: Published whole-form profiles generated by tools/word_profiles.py, inspected here descriptively only.
experiments/yolo/gdt380_identity_free_functional_transfer/REPORT.md and METHOD.md, for known existing comparator availability and the previous transfer failure.
experiments/yolo/gdt749_outside_frame_whole_role_distribution/REPORT.md, preserving the failed 23 TP / 42 FP / 60 FN role-profile calibration.
research_registry/proposals/laufenberg_f85r2_20260926/WORD_SELECTION_REPORT.md, preserving the purely descriptive current frequency audit.
design.predecessor_boundary: GDT380 already failed to transfer identity-free local behavioral signatures, and GDT749's inherited-label role classifier was poorly calibrated. Do not rerun their detectors or silently relax their gates. This raw variant asks a narrower, source-semantic question about whole-concept demand under an explicitly paid lexical encoding model; it must be screened against additional primary predecessors before selection. GDT611 still prevents semantic naming from form-only label permutations.
design.meaning_relevant_decision: A surviving source envelope would justify preferring broad-role whole-reading hypotheses over narrow season names for a highly distributed whole, only within the declared encoding/document model. An overlapping envelope leaves both hypotheses live and ends this route; it does not justify a larger classifier.
failure_conditions: Fewer than three independently readable suitable complete source works are already available: missing input, stop without new acquisition.
Concept annotation or source unit boundaries require guessed source meanings or target-informed choices: invalid test, stop.
High-frequency narrow concepts overlap function-word footprints on complete held source works: no discriminating prior.
Encoding-granularity sensitivity reverses the priority: no transferable prior.
Different semantic names still give exactly the same observables after source linkage: missing meaning binding, not evidence for the favored name.
design.smallest_test_and_budget: Before substantial implementation, a 25-minute source-only feasibility pass must fix at most eight already specified concepts across the complete bounded cached units of three works, manually audit the counted uses, and determine whether a transfer comparison is even meaningful. At the checkpoint, stop or separately register the smallest comparison. No new general model, corpus acquisition or decoder.
forbidden_inference: Rank one means conjunction or pronoun.
Ubiquity alone rules out every winter or plant interpretation.
Source frequency similarity establishes a translated word.
Successful source transfer supplies independent target confirmation.
A surviving prior rescues GDT380, GDT611, GDT749 or the original free seasonal assignments.
design.duplicate_screen: Bounded registry queries for frequency, word class, burstiness, dispersion, daiin/person, semantic priors and semantic concept frequency; route-check for semantic prior/frequent content/function; read GDT025, GDT301, GDT380, GDT737, GDT749 and GDT611 primary reports. Empty exact searches were not treated as proof of novelty. Relevant IDEA000005/000007/000017 missing-binding decisions remain unchanged.
